title: With non-grouped windows, audio icon shown on all windows sharing a PID and parent program, not just the window actually playing sound
line: With task grouping off, only the browser window that is playing sound shows the audio indicator and volume controls, not every window of the browser.
explanation: The task manager links audio streams to tasks only by process ID, and browsers play the sound of every window from one process, so every window of the browser got the audio indicator, the volume slider in its tooltip and the mute action. The window titles already tell which window is playing: Chrome's MPRIS track and Firefox's stream name (media.name) are the playing tab's title, which is also the window title while that tab is shown. Now, when several top-level windows share the stream's process, the streams are kept only on the window whose title contains the stream name or the playing track; if no window title matches (e.g. the playing tab is in the background), all windows keep them as before. The check reruns when window titles, the task list or the MPRIS players change.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: show the audio indicator only on the playing window

With grouping off, every window of a process got the audio indicator and
volume controls, as streams only carry a PID. When one of these windows
has the stream name or playing track in its title, only that one gets it.

BUG: 375943

media.caption: Master, grouping off: Chrome's quiet window (middle) and playing window (right) both show the audio indicator
Fixed: only the playing window shows it
Master: the quiet window's tooltip has the volume slider of the other window's audio (sweep tester's shot, same setup)
Fixed: no volume slider on the quiet window (the media controls row is fixed separately by bug 455654)

review.text: The cause (streams only carry a PID) can't be fixed in Plasma, so matching the stream name or MPRIS track against window titles is a reasonable heuristic with a safe fallback to the old behaviour when nothing matches. Scoped to ungrouped, non-popup tasks with several windows of the same PID, so single-window apps and groups are untouched. Before/after show the indicator moving from both Chrome windows to the playing one only. Reviewers may question the title heuristic and the per-task scan of tasksModel on title changes, but it is small and contained.
